[[Azure system]] |retired= |affiliation=Confederacy of Independent Systems |navy=[[Confederacy of Independent Systems Navy]] |fleet=[[Trench's fleet]] |owners= |captains=[[Trench]] |registry= |aliases= }} The '''''Invulnerable''''' was a [[Providence-class Dreadnought|''Providence''-class Dreadnought]], that served within the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems Navy|naval branch]] of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems|Separatist Alliance]] during the [[Clone Wars]]. The [[warship]] was utilized as the [[command ship]] and [[flagship]] of [[Harch]] Separatist [[Admiral]] [[Trench]] in a [[Battle of Anaxes|campaign]] on the [[planet]] [[Anaxes]] amid the [[Outer Rim Sieges]] in [[19 BBY]]. It also served as the primary warship of [[Trench's fleet]] during the battle, which fought to claim control over vital [[Galactic Republic]] [[shipyard]]s on the surface. Towards the battle's end, however, a [[Clone Force 99|squad]] of Republic [[clone commando]]s led by [[Jedi General]] [[Anakin Skywalker]] infiltrated the ''Invulnerable'' during their effort to reclaim Anaxes from the Confederacy. Aboard the dreadnought, the Republic utilized the warship's communication systems to activate an engineered feedback pulse, which deactivated the [[Separatist Droid Army]] fighting on the surface. Thereafter, the Harch was killed aboard his flagship following his activation of a bomb in the [[Anaxes shipyards|manufacturing facility]], which in turn led to the ''Invulnerable''{{'s}} destruction by an implemented [[self-destruct mechanism]]. ==Description== A [[Providence-class Dreadnought|''Providence''-class Dreadnought]], the ''Invulnerable'' was constructed in the [[Factory|manufacturing facilities]] on the [[planet]] [[Pammant]] by the [[Quarren]] builders of [[Free Dac Volunteers Engineering Corps]]. In possession of a command [[Bridge (starship)|bridge]], from which the [[Starship|vessel]] was operated by a crew of [[B1-series battle droid]]s, the [[dreadnought]] was propelled by three [[Creveld-4 radial ion drive]]s manufactured by [[Nubia Star Drives, Incorporated|Nubia Star Drives, Inc.]], which were located at its stern. The ''Invulernable'' was also equipped with a starboard [[hangar]] bay, alongside several [[Comm unit|communications]] and [[sensor]] masts situated along the [[hull]] of its dorsal surface. To an additional degree, the warship was armed with various weapon systems across its hull, such as numerous heavy [[quad turbolaser cannon]]s and dual [[heavy laser cannon]]s, the former of which were located along its dorsal and starboard surface and the latter along its ventral hull. The ''Invulernable'' was also equipped with onboard [[Scanner|scanning]] systems, which were capable of detecting approaching vessels, as well as their starship class. Within its interior, from where the warship carried several B1-series [[battle droid]]s, [[B2-series super battle droid]]s, and [[BX-series droid commando]]s, the dreadnought contained a series of hallways and corridors that were patrolled by [[security droid]]s. Its interior also possessed an area from which the vessel's communications vault, constructed amid the [[Battle of Anaxes]], was located. The ''Invulernable''{{'s}} communications vault could be operated by an individual equipped with a scomp link, from where they could access the vessel's transmitters and relay instructions to [[Separatist Droid Army|ground forces]] or the warship's command bridge. Aboard the bridge itself, the operating crew was provided with a 180-degree panoramic view of the surrounding [[Realspace|space]] from multiple [[viewport]]s. It also possessed several display screens for its crew and [[commanding officer]], the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems|Separatist Alliance]] [[Admiral]] [[Trench]], to observe surface engagements and for its crew to operate the vessel's systems. Furthermore, the ''Invulernable'' was armed with an implemented [[self-destruct mechanism]], which was initiated by a remote [[detonator]] located aboard the command bridge. ==History== ===Fighting for Anaxes=== In [[19 BBY]], during the final weeks''[[Star Wars: Battles that Changed the Galaxy]]'' of the [[Clone Wars]] fought between the [[Galactic Republic]] and Confederacy of Independent Systems,{{TCW|The Bad Batch (episode)}} the [[planet]]{{Databank|fort-anaxes|Fort Anaxes}} [[Anaxes]], which served as one of the Republic's largest [[shipyard]]s and strongholds during the war, was assaulted by Confederacy forces under the command of Harch Admiral Trench. Commanding the battle at the head of a Separatist [[fleet]] in [[orbit]] from his [[flagship]], ''Invulnerable'', Trench was able to secure several key early victories through his [[droid]] forces, while also thinning the Republic's control over the world as a result of mounting losses and heated engagements. However, later in the engagement, Trench, aboard the ''Invulnerable'', who had been suspected to have been countering the Republic's tactics through a [[clone trooper]]-designed [[Rex's battle strategy algorithm|strategy algorithm]], was alerted by his forces of an established connection with the [[Techno Union]] world of [[Skako Minor]], which the Separatist dreadnought had received the counteractive information to the Republic's engagements from. As a result, the Separatist admiral contacted the Techno Union's leader, [[Foreman]] [[Wat Tambor]], from the ''Invulnerable'' of the Republic's discovery of the algorithm's signal as he expressed that the corporation's operations were potentially [[Mission to Skako Minor (Clone Wars)|jeopardized]].{{TCW|A Distant Echo}} ===Republic infiltration=== {{Quote|While Master Windu leads a team to retake the assembly complex, the Bad Batch will escort me into Trench's new comm vault, which, according to current intel, is now located on this Separatist Dreadnought above Anaxes.|Echo, explaining his plan to defeat Trench|}} Following the Republic's mission to Skako Minor, [[Jedi General]] [[Anakin Skywalker]], alongside the [[clone commando]] [[squad]] [[Clone Force 99]] returned to Anaxes with the [[Advanced Recon Commando]] clone trooper, [[Echo|CT-1409]], otherwise known as "Echo," who had once been thought dead. Upon their return, the Republic began to strategize their reclamation of the planet, to which Echo explained that while Republic forces led by Jedi General Mace Windu assaulted the assembly complex, the clone trooper would be brought aboard the ''Invulnerable'' into the dreadnought's newly established communications vault by Clone Force 99. As the Republic's infiltration team approached the ''Invulnerable'', the team's [[Omicron-class attack shuttle|''Omicron''-class attack shuttle]] [[Marauder (Omicron-class)|''Marauder'']] was detected by the dreadnought's battle droid crew, who allowed the shuttle to land following its concealment as one of the Confederacy's shuttles. In response, the ''Marauder'' docked with the dreadnought's ventral docking bay as Skywalker, Echo and Clone Force 99 made their way to the communications vault. However, upon Windu's assault on the assembly complex, the ''Invulnerable'' transmitted a request to the Techno Union in an effort to coordinate a counterattack on the Republic through the strategy algorithm. As a result, Echo, who had gained access to the dreadnought's systems, intercepted Trench's transmission and secretly provided a new strategy, which stated that all Separatist ground forces were to be mobilized to the assembly plant, as the Republic would not dispatch reinforcements and would put all their faith in the Jedi. ===Destruction=== {{Quote|I've got a present for you, Wrecker.''"
"''Oh, seriously? I get to blow it up? The whole stinkin' thing?! This is the happiest day of my life.|Anakin Skywalker allows Wrecker to blow up the ''Invulnerable''|audio=PresentForWrecker-UB.flac|}} Following the arrival of the Separatist forces in the assembly complex, Echo proceeded to transmit a feedback pulse, which deactivated all battle droids engaged on the surface. As Trench observed the battle, the Harch grew frustrated as a result of the droid army's deactivation, to which Trench's [[Unidentified super tactical droid (Anaxes)|tactical droid]] informed him of their detection of an energy surge and subsequently detected its origination from aboard the ''Invulnerable''. Responding to the energy pulse, the Harch ordered the dispatchment of security droids to attack the infiltrators, as well as relayed subsequent orders on the activation of a bomb hidden within the assembly complex that was large enough to destroy most of the planet. However, while Echo provided the codes to deactivate the bomb, the clone trooper was prevented from relaying the final number as a result of signal jamming from the dreadnought's crew. As a result, as Trench proceeded to make his escape from the ''Invulnerable'', the Harch was forced into providing the final number following an incursion aboard the command bridge by Skywalker, which subsequently led to Trench's [[death]] at the Jedi's hands. While leaving the dreadnought aboard their shuttle, which followed a brief engagement with several battle droids, the ''Invulnerable'' was destroyed alongside several other Separatist warships by the activation of a self-destruct mechanism by the clone commando [[Wrecker]]. ==Commanders and crew== Commanded by the Harch Separatist Admiral Trench, the ''Invulnerable'' was operated by a crew of several B1-series battle droids from the vessel's command bridge. The dreadnought was also maintained to by Trench's personal [[ST-series military strategic analysis and tactics droid]], who informed the Harch of ongoing surface engagements. ==Behind the scenes== The ''Invulnerable'' was introduced, although only in the episode's opening newsreels, in "[[The Bad Batch (episode)|The Bad Batch]]," the first episode of the [[The Clone Wars: Season Seven|seventh season]] of the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series,{{SW|url=series/clone-wars/the-bad-batch-episode-guide|text="The Bad Batch" Episode Guide | The Clone Wars}} which aired on
